parts.summary: The State E-Rate Coordinator’s Alliance opposes limiting or sunsetting the E-Rate program, emphasizing its consistency with congressional directives in Section 254 of the Communications Act and its essential role in meeting connectivity needs for schools and libraries.
Recognizes the importance of E-Rate for schools and libraries to maintain broadband connectivity and requests further notice of proposed rules before final rules are issued.

The comment supports the continuation of special construction eligibility under Category 1 of the E-Rate program, emphasizing its cost-effectiveness and necessity for broadband connectivity in schools and libraries. It cites the program's history of eligibility and the need for ongoing support to meet congressional objectives.
